stock.description: Tian Cheng Holdings Limited primarily operates within the marine construction sector, with a core specialization in land reclamation projects. Complementing these activities, the company also offers vessel chartering services and undertakes a variety of other civil engineering works. Established on May 24, 2018, the firm is headquartered in Hong Kong.
